devices.notes: Measured 2026-10-20 on Windows (WDDM), GPU shared with other jobs (minimums used). mem_bytes_per_s: Q8_0 x A8 decode GEMV prototype over one layer's dense projections (attention + shared expert, 172 MB, CUDA graph) = 124 us/layer = 1.38 TB/s (big GEMVs 1.43-1.49 TB/s; 1.79 nominal). crossing_overhead_us: GPU->TCP->GPU minus TCP alone, p50 ~65 us (D2H 11-26 + H2D after idle 45-75); p99 adds ~150-300 us. step_overhead_us (derived): graph node 0.43 us + small dependent kernels (~3 us fixed each). prefill_ops_per_s stays an estimate: dense INT8 GEMM measures 560-690 TOPS, FP8 500-575, BF16 290-310; 150 assumes quantized grouped kernels at ~22 % of that. 'supports' is the PLANNED backend: today no engine runs these parts here.
